commits.subject: Restore thread timestamp maxima independently (#38893)
evidence: go test ./state -run TestStateRuntimeRestoresIndependentThreadTimestampMaxima -count=1; go test ./state -count=1

Go's loadThreadTimestamps used the same SELECT MAX(updated_at_ms), MAX(recency_at_ms) FROM threads as the pre-fix Rust; SQLite interprets the two-argument form as the scalar max() (same-row maximum / NULL semantics) rather than two independent column aggregates, so when the updated_at and recency_at maxima belong to different threads one counter was silently corrupted on reopen. Aligned to Rust's independent scalar subqueries (SELECT (SELECT MAX(updated_at_ms) FROM threads), (SELECT MAX(recency_at_ms) FROM threads)) and pinned the regression with two threads holding maxima in different rows, close + reopen, both counters verified (3000/4000).
